text:
Alex: Quick travel brain dump: offsite packing dilemma — suit jacket vs wrinkle-proof blazer? which do you bring if you're only doing one formal night?
Priya: Blazer 90% of the time. less bulk, breathable, and you can dress it up. also a mini steamer or hang in the bathroom with hot shower.
Jonah: I bring the suit jacket if I think photos will happen. otherwise blazer. also fold jacket over hanger trick: inside-out shoulders to avoid a crease.
Mina: Pro tip: roll the blazer in the middle and stuff socks into sleeves to keep shape. learned this on a terrible red-eye.
Diego: Important Q: checked luggage vs carry-on for a 36h conference? I hate waiting at baggage claim.
Alex: Carry-on unless you absolutely need shoes or bulky giveaways. saves time and drama.
Priya: Carry-on + a soft duffel that can squish under seat. I also bring a single small plastic grocery bag (for wet shoes after hikes). weird but useful.
Jonah: For international metros vs rideshare: metro if central and you have a card; rideshare if late and sketchy station. metro saves $$$ and usually faster during peak.
Mina: If you’re using metro, a tiny foldable tote helps for printed swag or laptop backups. fits in the outer pocket.
Diego: Has anyone had the adapter vs power-bank fight at airports? people hog outlets.
Alex: Short cable + 10k battery wins. Also bring a 2-port USB plug, so you can borrow one socket and share.
Priya: Emergency hotel key card hack: if the door sensor dies, sometimes swiping the card horizontally around the reader wakes it back up. Also tape a sticky note with room # inside the door so housekeeping doesn't lock it during late returns.
Jonah: Packing snippet I use for 1-night formal + 2 conference days:
```
- blazer (wear on plane)
- 2 shirts (one tucked in, one comfy)
- 1 pair chinos + belt
- short cable + battery
- earplugs + small med kit
- foldable tote + shoe bag
```
Mina: For wrinkle prevention: hang the blazer facing out, clip the bottom hem with a binder clip so it doesn't slide in the closet. hotel hangers are slippery.
Diego: Random: bring a printed little note with local emergency numbers + hotel address in native language. saved me when my phone died and I needed a taxi.
Alex: Poll: react :one: if you always check luggage, :two: carry-on only, :three: mix based on length.
Priya: :two:
Jonah: :three:
Mina: :two: + saved
Diego: :three: (depends on swag weight)
Alex: Nice. Ill compile a one-pager with these tiny tricks and drop in the offsite channel. feel free to DM more oddball hacks (shoe deodorizer packets, rubber band loops, etc.). thanks team!
